mapper.select: SELECT rr.*, ri.room_number, ai.name AS apartment_name, CASE rr.type WHEN 1 THEN '水电问题' WHEN 2 THEN '家具问题' WHEN 3 THEN '家电问题' WHEN 4 THEN '网络问题' WHEN 5 THEN '其他' END AS type_name, CASE rr.status WHEN 1 THEN '待处理' WHEN 2 THEN '处理中' WHEN 3 THEN '已完成' WHEN 4 THEN '已取消' END AS status_name FROM repair_record rr LEFT JOIN room_info ri ON rr.room_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN apartment_info ai ON ri.apartment_id = ai.id AND ai.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rr.is_deleted = 0 AND rr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rr.create_time DESC
